superseded_adjudication.reason: The null permuted complete KDD profiles across domains even though each profile is generated relative to a different domain-specific Single checkpoint. Those profiles are not exchangeable; the random grouping creates artificial mixed-model age minima and does not test whether a pre-fixed domain-to-age mapping replicates.
superseded_adjudication.evidence_retained: The first internal confirmation map and all raw measurements remain immutable descriptive evidence. Its 15/15 map replication cannot itself serve as the repaired confirmatory test.

phenomenon_name_cn: 共享桥域相位映射复现

fixed_prediction_from_two_prior_splits.origin: identical domain-level argmin maps on the 20-image discovery split and the 24-image first internal confirmation split

exclude: all historical measurement suffix stems present in the frozen source pool
tertiary_split.selection: stable SHA-256 identity ranking under this new protocol before pixel decoding

primary_test.observed_cell_map: domain-level argmin of mean image reciprocal_KDD for all 15 domain-time cells
primary_test.mapping_accuracy: number of the 15 observed cells exactly matching the fixed prediction
primary_test.null: within each bridge time, independently permute the five pre-fixed predicted ages across the five fixed domain identities; never move KDD profiles between model systems
primary_test.bootstrap: 5000 within-domain image resamples; recompute effective age per cell
support_requirements: at least 13/15 cells have bootstrap modal share >= 0.80 and the mode equals the fixed prediction
M16 and M32 effective ages agree in at least 14/15 cells
each bridge time retains at least three distinct ages and an age range >= 2

interpretation_if_supported: A fixed domain-to-task-specific-kernel-age map learned from two prior image splits replicates on a third zero-overlap image split. The shared AIO checkpoint is therefore phase-desynchronized across domains under this training realization.

claim_boundary.allowed: internal same-source, one-training-seed replication of an SB-native observational phase map

forbidden_post_effect_changes: drop a domain, bridge time, age, or image
move measured KDD profiles between domain-specific model systems
read targets or select by output quality
